en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 389 - It is narrated that he became the deputy of Yazidi at Basra
and remained at his service a long while and collected large amounts of money.
who arrested him and confiscated the money
and gave him a blow at the top of his head, so hard that fluids of his brain came to his eyes.
Abu Bakr died in this way.
